subject: spot

Simple composition, strong silhouettes, minimal background, clean edges so the illustration can sit beside printed text.

Strict palette: black, off-white paper, turquoise-cyan, amber-gold. No other colors, no gradients, no photographic lighting. Crisp ink linework, pochoir stencil color. No text, no lettering, no signature.
